svg.title: Recommended frontend architecture for Climate Compass
svg.desc: Three-tier frontend stack: SMS-first baseline, simple web dashboard, optional mobile app. Focus on low-bandwidth and offline-first design.

g.text: Simple text alerts: "HIGH AIR QUALITY. PM2.5: 188. Action: Stock O₂. Reply YES to confirm."
No internet required. Works on any phone. Health workers reply via SMS to log actions.
Tech: HTML5 + CSS3 + vanilla JavaScript (NO frameworks = fast load)
Display: Current AQ, risk score, recent alerts, facility action log
Admin view: Manage contacts, set alert thresholds, download data
Offline mode: Uses service worker + localStorage for 24h cache
React Native or Flutter app (for health workers)
Push notifications when high air quality alert triggered
Action checklist: O₂ stocked / Staff called / Protocols reviewed
Offline-first: App syncs with backend when online
